# Now, let's match the songs in the playlists to the "songs_to_archive" list.
# We'll match by "Song Title by Artist Name" (as in the archive list).
# We'll build a mapping of playlist_id -> [song_ids_to_remove], and also collect all song_ids to add to "Old Songs".

# Prepare a mapping from song_id to "Song Title by Artist Name"
song_id_to_full_title = {}
for song_id, info in song_details.items():
    # If multiple artists, join with ", "
    artist_names = ", ".join([artist["name"] for artist in info["artists"]])
    full_title = f'{info["title"]} by {artist_names}'
    song_id_to_full_title[int(song_id)] = full_title

# Find which song_ids match the archive list
archive_set = set(songs_to_archive)
playlist_songs_to_remove = {}  # playlist_id -> [song_ids]
all_song_ids_to_archive = set()

for pl in playlists:
    to_remove = []
    for sid in pl["song_ids"]:
        if song_id_to_full_title.get(sid) in archive_set:
            to_remove.append(sid)
            all_song_ids_to_archive.add(sid)
    if to_remove:
        playlist_songs_to_remove[pl["playlist_id"]] = to_remove

# Show which songs will be removed from which playlists, and the full list to add to "Old Songs"
print({"playlist_songs_to_remove": playlist_songs_to_remove, "all_song_ids_to_archive": list(all_song_ids_to_archive)})
